reserveReview.rationale: Plume's current documentation identifies pUSD as a 1:1 USDC wrapper and lists native USDC plus legacy USDC.e on Plume. Same-run reads at Ethereum block 25796849 (2026-08-20T14:12:59Z) found 50,155.811387 pUSD and 548,548.358112 native USDC in the BoringVault. At Plume block 88408208 (2026-08-20T14:13:04Z), the vault held 3,405,529.686841 native USDC and 650,227.999145 USDC.e against 4,554,150.234360 pUSD. Across both deployments, 4,604,306.044098 USDC claims reconcile to 4,604,306.045747 pUSD (0.001649-token difference); the current normalized mix is 85.87782843% native USDC and 14.12217157% bridged USDC.e. The bridged slice remains medium for the additional bridge contract path.
